title: I have launched my first game on Steam after 4 months of vibing!
author: StarDrifterG
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I've been working on The Pilot

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5131820/The\_Pilot/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5131820/The_Pilot/)

Around 50% of the development was done with the help of Claude Code.

My approach was to combine Claude Code with MCP tools to create a more integrated development workflow rather than just using AI to generate code.

The general process involved:

* Designing gameplay mechanics using my own brain!
* Implementing features and refactoring existing Godot scripts with Claude and GPT.
* Using MCP integrations with Blender, PixelLab, and ElevenLabs to extend Claude's capabilities beyond code generation.

I'd love to hear your feedback on the gameplay shown in the trailer, the visual style, and the overall concept.

Thanks!
